title: प्रथमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 1 · The armies assemble at Kurukshetra

summary.en: Janamejaya asks how the heroes fought, and Vaishampayana begins the account. The Kauravas and Pandavas camp on Kurukshetra and agree on rules of fair combat.
summary.kn: ವೀರರು ಹೇಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿದರೆಂದು ಜನಮೇಜಯ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ವೈಶಂಪಾಯನ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಆರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕೌರವ-ಪಾಂಡವರು ಕುರುಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೀಡುಬಿಟ್ಟು ನ್ಯಾಯಯುದ್ಧದ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: जनमेजय पूछते हैं कि वीरों ने कैसे युद्ध किया, और वैशम्पायन वृत्तान्त आरम्भ करते हैं। कौरव और पाण्डव कुरुक्षेत्र में डेरा डालते हैं और न्यायपूर्ण युद्ध के नियम तय करते हैं।
summary.te: వీరులు ఎలా పోరాడారని జనమేజయుడు అడుగగా వైశంపాయనుడు కథ ప్రారంభిస్తాడు. కౌరవ పాండవులు కురుక్షేత్రంలో విడిది చేసి న్యాయయుద్ధ నియమాలను అంగీకరిస్తారు.
summary.ta: வீரர்கள் எவ்வாறு போரிட்டனர் என்று ஜனமேஜயன் கேட்க, வைசம்பாயனர் கதையைத் தொடங்குகிறார். கௌரவர்களும் பாண்டவர்களும் குருக்ஷேத்திரத்தில் தங்கி நியாயப் போருக்கான விதிகளை ஏற்கிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: ജനമേജയൻ വീരന്മാർ എങ്ങനെ യുദ്ധം ചെയ്തു എന്ന് ചോദിക്കുന്നു; വൈശമ്പായനൻ വിവരണം തുടങ്ങുന്നു. കുരുക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ കൗരവരും പാണ്ഡവരും പാളയമടിച്ച് ന്യായമായ യുദ്ധനിയമങ്ങൾ അംഗീകരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.1; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
कथं युयुधिरे वीराः कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः ।
पार्थिवाश्च महाभागा नानादेशसमागताः ॥

meaning.en: How did the heroes of the Kurus, Pandavas and Somakas, and the great kings gathered from many lands, come to fight each other?

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
यथा युयुधिरे वीराः कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः ।
कुरुक्षेत्रे तपःक्षेत्रे शृणु तत्पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: Listen, lord of the earth, how the heroes of the Kurus, Pandavas and Somakas fought on Kurukshetra, the field of austerities.

verses.text:
अवतीर्य कुरुक्षेत्रं पाण्डवाः सहसोमकाः ।
कौरवानभ्यवर्तन्त जिगीषन्तो महाबलाः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas and Somakas came down to Kurukshetra, mighty and eager for victory, and moved against the Kauravas.

verses.text:
वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नाः सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः ।
आशंसन्तो जयं युद्धे वधं वाभिमुखा रणे ॥

meaning.en: All of them were learned in the Vedas and delighted in battle; facing the foe they hoped for victory in the fight, or else death.

verses.text:
अभियाय च दुर्धर्षां धार्तराष्ट्रस्य वाहिनीम् ।
प्राङ्मुखाः पश्चिमे भागे न्यविशन्त ससैनिकाः ॥

meaning.en: Approaching the unassailable host of Dhritarashtra's son, they and their troops encamped on the western side, facing east.

verses.text:
समन्तपञ्चकाद्बाह्यं शिबिराणि सहस्रशः ।
कारयामास विधिवत्कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, had thousands of camps laid out properly outside Samantapanchaka.

verses.text:
शून्येव पृथिवी सर्वा बालवृद्धावशेषिता ।
निरश्वपुरुषा चासीद्रथकुञ्जरवर्जिता ॥

meaning.en: The whole earth seemed empty, with only children and the old left, without horses or men, without chariots and elephants.

verses.text:
यावत्तपति सूर्यो हि जम्बूद्वीपस्य मण्डलम् ।
तावदेव समावृत्तं बलं पार्थिवसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Best of kings, as far as the sun shines over the circle of Jambudvipa, so far the gathered forces extended.

verses.text:
एकस्थाः सर्ववर्णास्ते मण्डलं बहुयोजनम् ।
पर्याक्रामन्त देशांश्च नदीः शैलान्वनानि च ॥

meaning.en: People of all classes assembled together and spread over a region many yojanas wide, covering lands, rivers, mountains and forests.

verses.text:
तेषां युधिष्ठिरो राजा सर्वेषां पुरुषर्षभ ।
आदिदेश सवाहानां भक्ष्यभोज्यमनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Bull among men, King Yudhishthira ordered the finest food and drink for all of them and their mounts.

verses.text:
संज्ञाश्च विविधास्तास्तास्तेषां चक्रे युधिष्ठिरः ।
एवंवादी वेदितव्यः पाण्डवेयोऽयमित्युत ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira also set various signals for the troops, so that one could know, "This one speaking so is a Pandava man."

verses.text:
अभिज्ञानानि सर्वेषां संज्ञाश्चाभरणानि च ।
योजयामास कौरव्यो युद्धकाल उपस्थिते ॥

meaning.en: When the time of battle arrived, the Kuru prince fixed identifying marks, signals and ornaments for them all.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा ध्वजाग्रं पार्थानां धार्तराष्ट्रो महामनाः ।
सह सर्वैर्महीपालैः प्रत्यव्यूहत पाण्डवान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the banner tops of the sons of Pritha, the high-minded son of Dhritarashtra drew up his army with all the kings against the Pandavas.

verses.text:
पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि ।
मध्ये नागसहस्रस्य भ्रातृभिः परिवारितम् ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana stood with a white parasol held over his head, amid a thousand elephants and surrounded by his brothers.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं हृष्टाः सर्वे पाण्डवसैनिकाः ।
दध्मुः सर्वे महाशङ्खान्भेरीर्जघ्नुः सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him, all the Pandava soldiers rejoiced, blew great conchs and beat thousands of drums.

verses.text:
ततः प्रहृष्टां स्वां सेनामभिवीक्ष्याथ पाण्डवाः ।
बभूवुर्हृष्टमनसो वासुदेवश्च वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: Then the Pandavas, seeing their own army in high spirits, grew glad at heart, and so did the mighty Vasudeva.

verses.text:
ततो योधान्हर्षयन्तौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ ।
दध्मतुः पुरुषव्याघ्रौ दिव्यौ शङ्खौ रथे स्थितौ ॥

meaning.en: Then Vasudeva and Dhananjaya, tigers among men, cheering the warriors, blew their divine conchs as they stood in their chariot.

verses.text:
पाञ्चजन्यस्य निर्घोषं देवदत्तस्य चोभयोः ।
श्रुत्वा सवाहना योधाः शकृन्मूत्रं प्रसुस्रुवुः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the roar of the Panchajanya and of the Devadatta, the warriors and their mounts passed dung and urine in fear.

verses.text:
यथा सिंहस्य नदतः स्वनं श्रुत्वेतरे मृगाः ।
त्रसेयुस्तद्वदेवासीद्धार्तराष्ट्रबलं तदा ॥

meaning.en: As other beasts tremble at the roar of a lion, so did the army of Dhritarashtra's son then.

verses.text:
उदतिष्ठद्रजो भौमं न प्राज्ञायत किंचन ।
अन्तर्धीयत चादित्यः सैन्येन रजसावृतः ॥

meaning.en: Dust rose from the ground and nothing could be seen; the sun vanished, covered by the dust of the army.

verses.text:
ववर्ष चात्र पर्जन्यो मांसशोणितवृष्टिमान् ।
व्युक्षन्सर्वाण्यनीकानि तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then a cloud rained a shower of flesh and blood, drenching all the divisions, which seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
वायुस्ततः प्रादुरभून्नीचैः शर्करकर्षणः ।
विनिघ्नंस्तान्यनीकानि विधमंश्चैव तद्रजः ॥

meaning.en: Then a low wind arose, dragging gravel along, striking those divisions and scattering the dust.

verses.text:
उभे सेने तदा राजन्युद्धाय मुदिते भृशम् ।
कुरुक्षेत्रे स्थिते यत्ते सागरक्षुभितोपमे ॥

meaning.en: King, the two armies, standing at Kurukshetra, were very joyful for battle and looked like two surging seas.

verses.text:
तयोस्तु सेनयोरासीदद्भुतः स समागमः ।
युगान्ते समनुप्राप्ते द्वयोः सागरयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: The meeting of those two armies was wondrous, like two oceans meeting when an age comes to its end.

verses.text:
शून्यासीत्पृथिवी सर्वा बालवृद्धावशेषिता ।
तेन सेनासमूहेन समानीतेन कौरवैः ॥

meaning.en: The whole earth was empty, with only children and the old left, because of the host that the Kauravas had gathered.

verses.text:
ततस्ते समयं चक्रुः कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः ।
धर्मांश्च स्थापयामासुर्युद्धानां भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then the Kurus, Pandavas and Somakas made an agreement and set down rules for the fighting, O best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
निवृत्ते चैव नो युद्धे प्रीतिश्च स्यात्परस्परम् ।
यथापुरं यथायोगं न च स्याच्छलनं पुनः ॥

meaning.en: "When the battle ends, let there be affection among us again as before, as is fitting, and let there be no more treachery."

verses.text:
वाचा युद्धे प्रवृत्ते नो वाचैव प्रतियोधनम् ।
निष्क्रान्तः पृतनामध्यान्न हन्तव्यः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: "Where the fight is waged with words, let the reply be with words only; one who has left the army's midst must never be killed."

verses.text:
रथी च रथिना योध्यो गजेन गजधूर्गतः ।
अश्वेनाश्वी पदातिश्च पदातेनैव भारत ॥

meaning.en: "A chariot-warrior must fight a chariot-warrior, one on an elephant an elephant-rider, a horseman a horseman, and a foot soldier a foot soldier, O Bharata."

verses.text:
यथायोगं यथावीर्यं यथोत्साहं यथावयः ।
समाभाष्य प्रहर्तव्यं न विश्वस्ते न विह्वले ॥

meaning.en: "Strike only after warning, according to fitness, strength, spirit and age; never one who is trusting or panicked."

verses.text:
परेण सह संयुक्तः प्रमत्तो विमुखस्तथा ।
क्षीणशस्त्रो विवर्मा च न हन्तव्यः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: "One who is engaged with another, one who is careless or turned away, one whose weapons are spent or who lacks armour must never be killed."

verses.text:
न सूतेषु न धुर्येषु न च शस्त्रोपनायिषु ।
न भेरीशङ्खवादेषु प्रहर्तव्यं कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: "No blow may be struck at charioteers, at draught animals, at those who carry weapons, or at those who sound drums and conchs."

verses.text:
एवं ते समयं कृत्वा कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः ।
विस्मयं परमं जग्मुः प्रेक्षमाणाः परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: Having made this agreement, the Kurus, Pandavas and Somakas looked at one another in great amazement.

verses.text:
निविश्य च महात्मानस्ततस्ते पुरुषर्षभाः ।
हृष्टरूपाः सुमनसो बभूवुः सहसैनिकाः ॥

meaning.en: Then those great-souled bulls among men, with their soldiers, settled down with glad faces and cheerful hearts.
